svg.title: Amendia agent-runtime in nemoclaw execution mode with NVIDIA OpenShell and NIM
svg.desc: In nemoclaw mode capability execution moves out of the agent-runtime process into a capability-worker running inside an NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox. Because an OpenShell sandbox is egress-only and has no inbound serving, the transport is inverted: the host publishes a job onto RabbitMQ and the worker, which dials out to the broker, consumes it and publishes a correlated reply. The host keeps every Mongo write, the LangGraph checkpoint that is the audit record, and the human-in-the-loop lifecycle. The sandbox reaches only four allowlisted endpoints: the broker over AMQP, managed inference at inference.local, MCP tool servers, and the OTLP collector. Real secrets stay gateway-side.
svg.text: Amendia — agent-runtime in nemoclaw mode (NVIDIA OpenShell + NIM)
AGENTRT_EXECUTION_MODE=nemoclaw · assumes GPU capacity provisioned. ADR-017/018/019/020/021/023. Read-verified 2026-08-19.
HOST — agent-runtime (trusted)
Owns audit. Never moves.
Stays on the host: checkpointing, the HITL
task lifecycle, artifact-schema validation and
all governed-event publishing.
ADR-017 trap 2 — never let the sandbox own
the audit write.
RabbitMQ
The inverted transport

g.text: The host never dials the sandbox.

NVIDIA OPENSHELL BOUNDARY
openshell CLI v0.0.80 (NVIDIA, Apache-2.0)

g.text: holds the REAL secrets · sets + hot-reloads sandbox policy

svg.text: Sandbox — egress-only, default-deny
openshell sandbox create --from <capability-worker image> --policy <yaml>
Executes one capability per job: skill · llm · mcp · deep_agent (ADR-021, nemoclaw-only).
Secrets are PLACEHOLDERS here — real credentials resolve gateway-side (ADR-016 trap 1).
Policy hot-reloads into a running sandbox; a worker reconnect is a broker blip, not a policy edit.
Fail-closed in prod: AGENTRT_NEMOCLAW_REQUIRED=true — unreachable broker ⇒ refuse to start.
Memoization mandatory (ADR-019): the reviewed artifact is the committed one — no re-invoke on resume.
GPU assumed provisioned; NIM scheduling = nodeSelector + tolerations + nvidia.com/gpu.
Helm ships openshell.sandbox.enabled=false today — baseline is a hardened worker Deployment.
SANDBOX EGRESS — default-deny, four explicit allowlist entries
openshell policy update <sandbox> --add-endpoint 'host:port:read-write' · formal check: openshell policy prove
Egress is set at sandbox-creation time and hot-reloadable. Per-binary scoping via --binary. Everything not listed here is denied by default.
CONFIRMED — stood up live (ADR-023)
• Real openshell CLI v0.0.80 installed; command surface captured — the guessed
verbs used across ADR-017…022 were replaced with the real ones.
• Gateway started (Docker driver auto-detected) + a real sandbox container created.
• The AMQP make-or-break: an endpoint with host+port and NO protocol key is accepted
and loads as TCP passthrough — so the worker CAN reach RabbitMQ. Proven at the
policy layer, and openshell policy prove ran.
• Policy changes hot-reload into a running sandbox.
• A custom worker image is placeable: sandbox create --from <image-ref|Dockerfile|dir>.
NOT YET CONFIRMED — do not present as running
⚠ Data-plane byte flow to RabbitMQ was BLOCKED by an environment egress-proxy
limitation — it affects all egress, not AMQP specifically. Unproven end to end.
• Live inference through inference.local still needs an operator credential.
• OpenShell ships a Kubernetes driver (--driver-config-json {"kubernetes":…}) so the
mechanism exists — but full production wiring on a cluster is unvalidated.
⚠ The Helm chart gates the sandbox OFF (openshell.sandbox.enabled=false) with an
explicit # [confirm] + STOP. The supported posture today is the baseline: a plain
hardened capability-worker Deployment + NetworkPolicy, no OpenShell sandbox.
Supersedes the flowchart in amendia_secure_runtime_nemoclaw_plan.md §11, which still shows a host→gateway "execute RPC". That RPC does not exist — ADR-019 found
OpenShell has no host→sandbox execute path, and ADR-020 replaced it with the broker request/reply drawn above. The plan-doc diagram predates that decision.
